Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack10-CentralBank01]:
This is a state-of-the-art supertall skyscraper, which will be the central piece of your financial district with its integrated subway terminal. Enjoying the benefits of its HQ located in your city, the bank provides better interest rates for your citizens and industry.
Height: {350:Height}.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack10-Centra: Integrates a functional subway terminal on the ground floor of the building, capable of supporting 4 platform stops.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack10-RHSignature02]:
A massive residential complex that spans across multiple city blocks, which provides housing and recreational areas for thousands of residents. Complex can be upgraded into a hospital with public parking lot, and a disease control center.
Highest tower: {290:Height}.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack10-RHSign: With its unique elevated structure, the downtown hospital provides medical coverage across the city. The complex includes a large underground bay for ambulances, a multi-story underground public parking lot, and two helipads reserved for medical use.

Disease Control Center provides experimental medical care and monitors the city against emergencies threatening public healthcare. Two helipads are reserved for medical interventions.
Height: {330:Height}.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack10-RHSignature03]:
A supertall skyscraper that provides housing and amenities for its residents. Dragon-scaled rooftop floor gives the building its name, and it features an observation deck. The building can expand into an education complex with its college and geotechnical institute upgrades.
Height: {600:Height}.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack10-RHSign:
The Geotechnical Institute runs experimental research on geology and natural resources, while collaborating with the education branch and key industrial players of the city.
Height: {194:Height}.

Combining functionality of a college and a library together, this complex provides high-quality education more efficiently.
Height: {78:Height}.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack10-PostOffice01]:
Built in International Style and perfect for busy city centers, it includes a post office and underground parking. Can be upgraded to include a Postal Services headquarters with a sorting facility, and a downtown restaurant with a relaxing space for both locals and workers.
Height: {116:Height}.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack10-PostOf: The additional tower serves as the headquarters of Postal Services, adding an underground sorting facility, increasing the efficiency of office and industrial sectors.
The downtown restaurant is a local attraction in your downtown, increasing well-being and happiness.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack10-RMSignature02]:
A residential housing complex, built in a contemporary design. Providing spectacular to its residents from both towers, it has various shops on the ground levels and can be expanded to feature a first-class wellness center for its residents and locals.
Highest Tower: {205:Height}.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack10-RMSign: A multi-floor wellness center complex, which features a gym, indoor areas for activities, and an open-air swimming pool located on the top floor.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack10-RMSignature03]:
A residential skyscraper that carries the design language of the 1970s post-Mid-Century era. It features a large parking lot for its residents, with a small city park. It can be upgraded to a Police Station, which adds a dedicated workspace, and decorative pool.
Height: {127:Height}.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack10-RMSign:
The police station upgrade provides a dedicated second tower for law enforcement and administration offices, as well as a dedicated parking lot for patrol cars.
Height: {177:Height}.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack10-MSignature01]:
Redefine your skyline with Hurston Yards, a massive, mixed-use urban development featuring shopping spaces, leisure, and residential areas. Expandable with an additional skyscraper and observation deck, Hurston Yards will become one of the signature icons of your downtown.
Height: {350:Height}.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack10-MSigna: Outdoor observation deck which citizens can visit.

Third tower expansion that can be placed within the main complex's range. The dedicated headquarters building for commercial operations boosts import/export capacity but increases garbage output in the industrial sector.
Height: {237:Height}.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack10-MSignature02]:
A contemporary mixed-use skyscraper at a modest height with commercial space boosting industrial efficiency. Outdoor green spaces across unique terraced floors provide breathing room for its residents in busy urban life. Can be expanded into fire station headquarters.
Height: {150:Height}.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack10-MSigna: Converts the parking space into a fully equipped fire station with multiple apparatus bays housing 16 fire trucks, 4 disaster response units, and 3 fire helicopters.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack10-MSignature03]:
Sleek and futuristic, with a rhythmic pattern of windows, balconies, and curved structure, Emerald Towers is a mixed-use building complex that features commercial space on the lower section and residential space in its twin skyscrapers. Can be expanded into elementary school.
Height: {130:Height}.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack10-MSigna: Integrated elementary school that is placed on top of commercial space, while increasing the height of the shorter tower.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack10-OHSignature01]:
A classic example of timeless International Style, this office tower can also serve as a city hall that will be a central piece of any urban district.
Height: {157:Height}.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack10-OHSign: City Hall maintains the coordination of different city services and budget management, including disaster responses.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack10-OHSignature02]:
A monolith, brutalist skyscraper designed to withstand any disaster, allows mysterious tenants to operate with zero disturbance. It can upgrade to have a Communications Array, Substation, and Emergency Shelter to protect citizens from an environmental disaster.. or a fallout.
Height: {163:Height}.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack10-OHSign: State-of-the-art communications array provides fast and reliable intercontinental communications.

Substation turns Long Wires into a transformer and battery station in the middle of the city. Power Lines can be connected above or below ground, allowing power delivery to the downtown. Batteries can be recharged in case of emergency, as long as the city locally produces electricity.
High-capacity urban emergency shelter that can house thousands of people, at the expense of less available space for vehicles.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack10-OHSignature03]:
Finanzturm carries the peak office skyscraper design from 1980s Europe. It houses companies operating in the financial sector, providing favorable interest rates to local companies and increasing the efficiency of the logistics chain.
Height: {194:Height}.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack10-OHSignature04]:
The Coruna is a medium-sized office tower that houses companies that operate in the IT sector. It can be upgraded into a university, which can be expanded into a complex of its own, containing auditoriums and a research wing for start-up tech companies.
Height: {160:Height}.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack10-OHSign: Additional auditoriums expand the capacity of the university. They can be placed multiple times within the building range.

Research Wing houses a plethora of tech start-ups. Their presence and research boost the industrial efficiency in electronics and university graduation rates.
Height: {190:Height}.
Converts the interior of The Coruna into a university after an expensive interior renovation.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack10-OHSignature05]:
Arroyo Seco is a modern skyscraper that provides ample office space for companies operating in various areas, surrounded by an urban park featuring a decorative pool. The building can be upgraded to a Police Headquarters to fight and reduce crime.
Height: {110:Height}.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack10-OHSign: Adds underground floors to house the police headquarters, providing patrol and surveillance units, as well as jails and air support. It also includes a large public parking lot for car-loving mayors.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack10-OHSignature06]:
This sleek and futuristic skyscraper houses engineering companies that boost local industry. Their breakthroughs in experimental technology help the city control pollution levels.
Height: {343:Height}.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack10-CHSignature01]:
The iconic International style skyscraper that makes any city skyline unique with its presence, attracting visitors from all over the world. Housing the headquarters of commercial brands in your city, this skyscraper also boosts the industrial efficiency of your city.
Height: {546:Height}.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack10-CHSign: Adds the shopping mall and outdoor areas to attract visitors. It also features a high-capacity, underground parking lot, managed by the city administration.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack10-CHSignature02]:
Kansai Tower is a stunning skyscraper ideal for any major city. It features shopping malls, restaurants, green spaces, and a rooftop observatory, making it a popular destination for citizens and visitors. The tower can also be upgraded to include a high school.
Height: {290:Height}.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack10-CHSign: Adds a high school with outdoor spaces to boost health and well-being of students.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack10-Bench01]: These simple wooden benches allow your citizens to relax in the hustle of urban life. Sitting directions are marked with an icon on the sides of the benches for convenience.
